jobs.title: Curriculum Developer - STEM And Robotics
jobs.description:
We are looking for a creative and technically curious **STEM Curriculum \& Learning Experience Designer** who can turn robotics and electronics concepts into simple, engaging, and enjoyable learning experiences for students.

This role is not just about writing documentation. You will think about how a student understands a concept, how they interact with a product, where they may get confused, and how the learning journey can be made more interesting and intuitive.

You will work closely with our robotics and product teams to create activity books, manuals, lesson content, worksheets, project guides, and student\-friendly documentation for robotics, electronics, drones, sensors, motors, and coding\-based products.

**Key Responsibilities:**  
1\. Design STEM curricula and learning experiences that simplify robotics and electronics concepts for students.  
2\. Create hands\-on activities, curriculum content, manuals, worksheets, and project guides.  
3\. Understand and test robotics and electronics products to develop accurate learning content.  
4\. Simplify technical concepts into engaging and easy\-to\-understand learning experiences.  
5\. Design creative learning flows that support effective student learning.  
6\. Develop complete product documentation, including content structures and step\-by\-step instructions.  
7\. Create diagrams and visual learning materials to support product understanding.  
8\. Develop troubleshooting guides to help students and users resolve common issues.  
9\. Manage end\-to\-end documentation while ensuring a clear and user\-friendly documentation experience.

Pay: ₹18,000\.00 \- ₹28,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person
